_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 7,000 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2009 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 7,000 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2009 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.13x; +24% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.03; conservative 2yr +120%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY08-FY08 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +57.1%/yr (Q2 FY10 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 129-trading-day ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +57.1%/yr (no FY08-FY08 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +57.1%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY08-FY08: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2010-05-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.13x (19.3% downside to Bear $15.57 / +153.5% upside to Bull $48.90) | Adj composite 3.36 vs market 1.33: gap +2.03 [UNDERVALUED] | +24% above the EPP floor $15.60 (60x FY10E $0.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: +120.5% total (+60.2%/yr) | At 74.2x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $25.51 sits at or below the BASE case; net revenue +23.9% YoY in Q1 FY10, forward revenues +55.7-58.5% (Q2 FY10 revenue guide (guidance update 8-K)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
